title: Hugging Face: tasks, the Hub and community models

videos.script: Hugging Face is where most open models live, from their makers and from everybody else. {{tasks}} It sorts them by task. Fifty-three of them. Chat is one. A small classifier, built for one job, can sort e-mail cheaper than any chat model. {{hub}} Every model is a repository with a history. Download it by name alone, and next month you may get different bytes. Pin the commit. {{cards}} The card on top is data as well as prose: licence, languages, task, and the model it came from. All of it typed by the author. {{community}} Last, the community's models. Fine-tunes, adapters, quantizations and merges. Five checks before trusting one, and the cases decide.
